l4_steps.name: Capture complaint from all omni-channel sources
l4_steps.input: Customer contact via email, web form, phone, app, or social media
l4_steps.output: New case record created with source channel tag and PNR/loyalty reference
l4_steps.kpi: Case capture rate 100%; average intake time <2 min per case
l4_steps.pain_point: Fragmented channel ingestion creates duplicate cases during IROPS spikes; Sprinklr social volume can exceed 5,000 mentions/hour post-disruption, overwhelming manual deduplication

l4_steps.name: Auto-classify complaint type and urgency tier
l4_steps.input: Case text, channel, booking reference, loyalty tier flag
l4_steps.output: Complaint category tag (delay, baggage, crew, billing, accessibility), urgency tier P1–P4
l4_steps.kpi: Auto-classification accuracy ≥85%; misclassification rate <5% (validated via monthly QA sample)
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-language free-text complaints require NLP models retrained quarterly; incorrect urgency triage causes P1 DOT-reportable cases to sit in general queue breaching 24-hour SLA

l4_steps.name: Screen for regulatory and safety escalation triggers
l4_steps.system: Salesforce Service Cloud + CAPA Tool (internal quality management)
l4_steps.output: Safety flag Y/N; DOT/regulatory escalation trigger Y/N; CAPA record opened if required
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of safety-tagged cases escalated within 15 min; DOT disability/discrimination complaints acknowledged within 24 hours (Part 259 mandate)
l4_steps.pain_point: DOT Part 259 requires written response to disability and discrimination complaints within 30 days — missed SLAs expose airline to civil penalties up to $27,500 per violation per passenger

l4_steps.name: Assign case to team and set SLA clock
l4_steps.role: Case Routing Engine / Customer Care Team Lead
l4_steps.input: Complaint category, urgency tier, regulatory flag, agent availability
l4_steps.output: Case assigned to agent or specialist queue; SLA deadline set and clock started
l4_steps.kpi: First-assignment accuracy ≥92%; reassignment rate <8%; queue assignment time <5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Staffing gaps during IROPS cause queue backlog exceeding 10x normal volume; SLA clock runs regardless of staffing levels — unmanaged queues result in mass SLA breaches during weather events

l4_steps.name: Retrieve booking and full interaction history
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS + Salesforce Service Cloud
l4_steps.input: PNR reference or loyalty number extracted from case
l4_steps.output: Full booking itinerary, prior complaint interactions, current loyalty tier status
l4_steps.kpi: History retrieval time <30 sec; data completeness ≥98% of cases with valid PNR
l4_steps.pain_point: Loyalty tier data sync between Altéa and Salesforce has a 15-min replication lag — agents may not see tier upgrades applied post-flight, causing incorrect resolution offers to premium members

l4_steps.name: Validate complaint facts against operational records
l4_steps.input: Booking history, delay codes from OCC, baggage scan log
l4_steps.output: Verified complaint facts with supporting operational evidence attached to case
l4_steps.kpi: Validation completion within 4 hours of case creation; evidence attach rate ≥95% of cases
l4_steps.pain_point: Baggage scan data in SITA WorldTracer is incomplete for interline segments handled by third-party ground handlers — evidence gaps reduce resolution quality and increase re-open rate

l4_steps.name: Code root cause category for the complaint
l4_steps.input: Verified complaint facts, operational evidence, delay reason codes
l4_steps.output: Root cause code applied (OTP failure, crew behavior, baggage mishandled, ancillary billing error, etc.)
l4_steps.kpi: Root cause coding accuracy ≥90% (validated via monthly QA review of 5% sample); uncoded case rate <2%
l4_steps.pain_point: Absence of real-time delay reason codes from OCC forces agents to use estimated codes — downstream analytics are skewed, undermining VoC programs and operational improvement targeting

l4_steps.name: Escalate complex cases to specialist team
l4_steps.role: Senior Customer Care Specialist / Legal / Safety Team
l4_steps.input: Complex case flag from root cause coding step
l4_steps.output: Case transferred to specialist queue with priority flag and investigation notes
l4_steps.kpi: Escalation acknowledgment within 2 hours; escalation rate <15% of total monthly cases
l4_steps.pain_point: Specialist queues during major IROPS reach 10x normal volume — SLA adherence for escalated cases drops below 60% during large-scale disruption events, compounding reputational damage

l4_steps.name: Determine resolution type and compensation eligibility
l4_steps.system: Salesforce Service Cloud + ATPCO Fare Rules Engine
l4_steps.input: Root cause code, customer loyalty tier, fare class, applicable regulatory entitlement (EU261, DOT)
l4_steps.output: Resolution recommendation: apology, miles award, travel voucher, cash refund, or re-accommodation
l4_steps.kpi: Resolution first-contact rate ≥65%; compensation accuracy ≥98% vs. entitlement rules
l4_steps.pain_point: EU261/2004 and DOT compensation rules differ by route and delay length — agents without automated rule-based guidance misapply entitlements, creating regulatory exposure and inconsistent customer outcomes

l4_steps.name: Post miles or issue electronic voucher compensation
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa Loyalty + Salesforce Service Cloud
l4_steps.input: Approved compensation type (miles quantity or voucher value) from step 3.1
l4_steps.output: Miles credited to loyalty account or e-voucher code issued and emailed to customer
l4_steps.kpi: Miles posting time <24 hours; voucher delivery <4 hours; posting error rate <0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa Loyalty API throttles under post-IROPS peak load — delayed miles postings trigger a second wave of inbound contacts from customers who see no credit, effectively doubling case volume

l4_steps.name: Process cash refund via PSS and finance system
l4_steps.role: Customer Care Agent / Finance Operations Team
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS + SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/AR)
l4_steps.input: Approved refund amount, original payment method, fare rules confirmation
l4_steps.output: Refund transaction initiated in PSS; AR credit note posted in SAP; customer confirmation sent
l4_steps.kpi: Refund processing time ≤7 business days for credit card purchases (DOT mandate); refund error rate <1%
l4_steps.pain_point: PSS-to-SAP finance integration runs nightly batch — refunds initiated late in the day risk missing the 7-day DOT credit card refund deadline, exposing the airline to enforcement action

l4_steps.name: Draft, approve, and send customer response
l4_steps.system: Salesforce Service Cloud (email template library + approval workflow)
l4_steps.input: Case facts, resolution decision, compensation confirmation
l4_steps.output: Approved response letter sent to customer via preferred channel
l4_steps.kpi: First response time ≤24 hours (P1), ≤72 hours (P2); post-response CSAT ≥4.2/5.0
l4_steps.pain_point: Single QA reviewer approving 200+ responses per day creates bottleneck — grammatical errors and inconsistent tone in templated responses damage brand perception and reduce CSAT scores

l4_steps.name: Confirm customer acceptance or re-open case
l4_steps.input: Customer reply or no-reply after 7-day post-response wait window
l4_steps.output: Case closed (accepted) or re-opened with escalation note and priority uplift
l4_steps.kpi: Re-open rate <12%; closure on first resolution ≥65%; external escalation (DOT/BBB) rate <0.5% of cases
l4_steps.pain_point: Customers escalating to DOT or BBB after case closure without prior follow-up — proactive satisfaction check within 48 hours reduces external escalation rate by approximately 30%

l4_steps.name: Log case outcome and enrich customer CRM profile
l4_steps.system: Salesforce Service Cloud + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Closed case with full resolution details and compensation record
l4_steps.output: Updated customer interaction history; CRM profile enriched with complaint category, root cause, and resolution
l4_steps.kpi: Profile update completion rate 100%; CRM data quality score ≥95% (measured via monthly data audit)
l4_steps.pain_point: Duplicate customer profiles created from multiple booking channels (direct, OTA, GDS) result in fragmented complaint history — agents cannot see prior grievances, causing repeat-issue blind spots

l4_steps.name: Aggregate complaint data for trend analysis
l4_steps.input: Closed case export with root cause codes, compensation amounts, resolution times, and SLA outcomes
l4_steps.output: Weekly complaint trend dashboard; top-10 root cause report; SLA compliance summary
l4_steps.kpi: Dashboard refresh ≤24 hours after week close; root cause coverage ≥95% of closed cases
l4_steps.pain_point: Inconsistent root cause coding across the agent population (no mandatory controlled vocabulary enforcement) degrades analytics reliability — requires monthly recalibration training sessions to maintain ≥90% accuracy

l4_steps.name: Measure NPS and CSAT from post-resolution survey
l4_steps.input: Closed cases with valid customer email and consent flag
l4_steps.output: NPS score, CSAT score per complaint category, verbatim feedback themes
l4_steps.kpi: Survey response rate ≥15%; complaint-handling NPS ≥+30; complaint CSAT ≥4.0/5.0
l4_steps.pain_point: Survey fatigue from overlapping post-flight, post-complaint, and post-service surveys reduces response rates to <10% in high-volume periods — low sample sizes make category-level NPS statistically unreliable for operational decisions

l4_steps.name: Route VoC insights to operational improvement owners
l4_steps.role: Process Improvement Manager / VoC Program Lead
l4_steps.system: Salesforce Service Cloud + Jira (improvement backlog tracking)
l4_steps.input: Weekly trend report, NPS/CSAT data, top root causes with frequency and cost impact
l4_steps.output: Improvement action items created in Jira, assigned to owning departments (OCC, Crew, Baggage, IT); revised SLA targets where warranted
l4_steps.kpi: ≥80% of top-10 root causes have assigned improvement owner within 5 business days of report publication
l4_steps.pain_point: Customer Care produces complaint analysis but operational teams (OCC, Crew, Ground Handling) have no formal SLA to respond to VoC findings — insights-to-action loop is broken, allowing chronic root causes to persist quarter over quarter
